summary: HR Professional with over 15 years of progressive experience in multi‑unit businesses, skilled in developing and implementing HR plans, conflict resolution, employment compliance, and staffing strategy.

experience.title: HR Director
responsibilities: Planned, organized, and implemented HR for New Kent horse track and 8 off‑track betting sites (~650 employees).
Reviewed federal and state laws to ensure compliance.
Provided employee relations guidance and conducted investigations.
Created and updated HR policies and procedures.
Assessed performance and issued disciplinary notices.
Developed job descriptions in compliance with FLSA.
Managed FMLA, STD/LTD, and Workers’ Compensation.
Handled WC claims and OSHA reporting.
Represented the company in unemployment, EEOC, and related hearings.
Administered benefits for 125 eligible employees, including reconciliation and monthly payments.
Recruited and hired seasonal employees and conducted new‑hire orientations.
Maintained HRIS (ADP Enterprise) and employee files.
Partnered on workforce reduction actions and severance packages.
Managed company donations and coordinated volunteer work.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Managed FMLA, STD, LTD, and Workers’ Compensation for a division of 30 TV stations and 1 communications company (~2,000 employees).
Maintained job requisition database and supported recruitment/retention.
Ensured EEO broad outreach and performance management planning.
Organized and trained field HR for annual benefits enrollment.
Delivered monthly HR reports to division HR Director and Corporate HR VP.
Provided employee relations counseling and investigations.
Participated in wellness, community outreach, and employee engagement initiatives.
Coordinated annual HR conference with corporate HR team.

experience.title: Benefits Administrator
responsibilities: Administered benefit plans for 27 newspapers and TV stations (~3,500 employees).
Processed daily enrollments using PeopleSoft 8.0.
Assisted corporate and field HR with benefits issues.
Supported the Benefits Director in planning and implementing annual open enrollment.
Ensured compliance with rules, regulations, and HIPAA.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
responsibilities: Managed HR for 4 daily and 2 weekly newspapers (~400 employees).
Reported payroll biweekly using Simplex/Winstar timekeeping system.
Recruited for open positions and managed onboarding.
Provided policy and procedure assistance to employees and managers.
Organized annual open enrollment for benefits.
Designed weekly and monthly HR and payroll reports.
Maintained PeopleSoft HRMS database and personnel files.
Responded to employment/wage verifications and conducted exit interviews.
Handled unemployment claims and completed wage surveys.
Administered COBRA, STD, LTD, WC files, and OSHA reporting.
Conducted annual anti‑harassment and safety training.
